en.text: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的话又临到我说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的話又臨到我說：

en.text: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

zhSimplified.text: 「人子啊，你要面向西珥山发预言，攻击它，

zhTraditional.text: 「人子啊，你要面向西珥山發預言，攻擊它，

en.text: and tell it, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you. I will make you a desolation and an astonishment.

zhSimplified.text: 对它说，主耶和华如此说：西珥山哪，我与你为敌，必向你伸手攻击你，使你荒凉，令人惊骇。

zhTraditional.text: 對它說，主耶和華如此說：西珥山哪，我與你為敵，必向你伸手攻擊你，使你荒涼，令人驚駭。

en.text: I will lay your cities waste, and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 我必使你的城邑变为荒场，成为凄凉。你就知道我是耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 我必使你的城邑變為荒場，成為淒涼。你就知道我是耶和華。

en.text: “‘“Because you have had a perpetual hostility, and have given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end,

zhSimplified.text: 因为你永怀仇恨，在以色列人遭灾、罪孽到了尽头的时候，将他们交与刀剑，

zhTraditional.text: 因為你永懷仇恨，在以色列人遭災、罪孽到了盡頭的時候，將他們交與刀劍，

en.text: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I will prepare you for blood, and blood will pursue you. Since you have not hated blood, therefore blood will pursue you.

zhSimplified.text: 所以主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，我必使你遭遇流血的报应，罪必追赶你；你既不恨恶杀人流血，所以这罪必追赶你。

zhTraditional.text: 所以主耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓，我必使你遭遇流血的報應，罪必追趕你；你既不恨惡殺人流血，所以這罪必追趕你。

en.text: Thus I will make Mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation. I will cut off from it him who passes through and him who returns.

zhSimplified.text: 我必使西珥山荒凉，令人惊骇，来往经过的人我必剪除。

zhTraditional.text: 我必使西珥山荒涼，令人驚駭，來往經過的人我必剪除。

en.text: I will fill its mountains with its slain. The slain with the sword will fall in your hills and in your valleys and in all your watercourses.

zhSimplified.text: 我必使西珥山满有被杀的人。被刀杀的，必倒在你小山和山谷，并一切的溪水中。

zhTraditional.text: 我必使西珥山滿有被殺的人。被刀殺的，必倒在你小山和山谷，並一切的溪水中。

en.text: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 我必使你永远荒凉，使你的城邑无人居住，你的民就知道我是耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 我必使你永遠荒涼，使你的城邑無人居住，你的民就知道我是耶和華。

en.text: “‘“Because you have said, ‘These two nations and these two countries will be mine, and we will possess it,’ although the LORD was there,

zhSimplified.text: 「因为你曾说：『这二国这二邦必归于我，我必得为业』（其实耶和华仍在那里），

zhTraditional.text: 「因為你曾說：『這二國這二邦必歸於我，我必得為業』（其實耶和華仍在那裏），

en.text: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord GOD, “I will do according to your anger, and according to your envy which you have shown out of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.

zhSimplified.text: 所以主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，我必照你的怒气和你从仇恨中向他们所发的嫉妒待你。我审判你的时候，必将自己显明在他们中间。

zhTraditional.text: 所以主耶和華說：我指着我的永生起誓，我必照你的怒氣和你從仇恨中向他們所發的嫉妒待你。我審判你的時候，必將自己顯明在他們中間。

en.text: You will know that I, the LORD, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, ‘They have been laid desolate. They have been given to us to devour.’

zhSimplified.text: 你也必知道我—耶和华听见了你的一切毁谤，就是你攻击以色列山的话，说：『这些山荒凉，是归我们吞灭的。』

zhTraditional.text: 你也必知道我－耶和華聽見了你的一切毀謗，就是你攻擊以色列山的話，說：『這些山荒涼，是歸我們吞滅的。』

en.text: You have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me. I have heard it.”

zhSimplified.text: 你们也用口向我夸大，增添与我反对的话，我都听见了。

zhTraditional.text: 你們也用口向我誇大，增添與我反對的話，我都聽見了。

en.text: The Lord GOD says: “When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.

zhSimplified.text: 主耶和华如此说：全地欢乐的时候，我必使你荒凉。

zhTraditional.text: 主耶和華如此說：全地歡樂的時候，我必使你荒涼。

en.text: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, so I will do to you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”

zhSimplified.text: 你怎样因以色列家的地业荒凉而喜乐，我必照你所行的待你。西珥山哪，你和以东全地必都荒凉。你们就知道我是耶和华。」

zhTraditional.text: 你怎樣因以色列家的地業荒涼而喜樂，我必照你所行的待你。西珥山哪，你和以東全地必都荒涼。你們就知道我是耶和華。」
